_why: What the golden harness itself may stop pinning (bin/goldens/golden_manifest.py): <cases> names a dropped case or cell, or a cell newly declared not applicable, as <set>.<list>:<item> (e.g. host_matrix.cells:medchron/busy); <normaliser> names a normaliser added, changed or removed (e.g. host_matrix_normal._ULID). Each entry is exact, reviewed with the PR, and cleared after it merges. The lifecycle matrix and run record PR (2026-11-17): every chronology record carries a run block (fields.run on the wire, metadata.run on the audit row, run_pending in the state between a resume and its start); an ending the broker did not take is kept as record_pending and recorded on a later tick, while the firm's message goes as before (medchron__broker_down_mid_run); the new host ending queued_behind_same_lane is not applicable to the note, negotiation and library setup lanes. The relay say check (2026-11-19): the decision corpus gains step 5a, the register read _plugin._TURN_SAYS.get unrecorded (None in every case but the say knob) and _say_held recorded, with two guard cases on a say knob. The citation exemption per session (R2.4, 2026-11-19): the relay passes this session's own rule sentences to the gate only when there are some (outbound_gate.gate_kwargs, unrecorded, {} in every case). Tier 1 of the mechanics check runs on every firm reply (turn_says.mechanics_hold, unrecorded, None in every case but mechanics_named).
